## Spec

A second normal run from an unrelated directory with an empty environment and only the three public code/input files produces identical output; audit observes no network or session/restricted-data access. Historical normal output and synthetic fixture bytes remain unchanged.
Historical task bodies are staged only as title stubs, and the original probe-source artifact is unavailable; exported #443/#446 reports and matching git blobs support the independently reconstructed probes. [Full evidence and rerunnable harness](artifacts/completion-review.md).
Recommendation: the next shaper can settle this pinned completion-guard prerequisite using the saved evidence; no further work remains in this review. Synthetic checks establish neither native LabVIEW benchmark readiness nor product permission.
